description: This PHP trait provides S3-specific functionality for the AWS SDK for PHP, including methods for uploading, copying, deleting objects, and bucket operations. It is meant to be used within classes implementing the S3ClientInterface.

classes.name: S3ClientTrait
classes.description: A trait providing S3-specific methods for an AWS SDK client, including object management and bucket operations.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Uploads an object to an S3 bucket synchronously by delegating to uploadAsync and waiting for the promise.

methods.name: uploadAsync
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous upload of an object to S3, returning a promise.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies an object within S3 synchronously by delegating to copyAsync and waiting for the promise.

methods.name: copyAsync
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous copy of an object within S3, returning a promise.

methods.name: registerStreamWrapper
methods.description: Registers the S3 stream wrapper for PHP, allowing s3:// stream access.

methods.name: registerStreamWrapperV2
methods.description: Registers an enhanced version of the S3 stream wrapper.

methods.name: deleteMatchingObjects
methods.description: Deletes objects matching a prefix or regex synchronously.

methods.name: deleteMatchingObjectsAsync
methods.description: Begins asynchronous deletion of objects matching criteria.

methods.name: uploadDirectory
methods.description: Uploads a directory to S3 synchronously.

methods.name: uploadDirectoryAsync
methods.description: Uploads a directory to S3 asynchronously.

methods.name: downloadBucket
methods.description: Downloads an entire S3 bucket to a local directory synchronously.

methods.name: downloadBucketAsync
methods.description: Downloads an S3 bucket asynchronously.

methods.name: determineBucketRegion
methods.description: Determines the region of a bucket synchronously.

methods.name: determineBucketRegionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously determines the region of a bucket.

methods.name: doesBucketExist
methods.description: Checks if a bucket exists using a HEAD request.

methods.name: doesBucketExistV2
methods.description: Checks if a bucket exists, with options for 403 acceptance.

methods.name: doesObjectExist
methods.description: Checks if an object exists in a bucket.

methods.name: doesObjectExistV2
methods.description: Checks if an object exists, considering delete markers.

methods.name: useDeleteMarkers
methods.description: Helper to determine if delete markers are used for an object.

methods.name: checkExistenceWithCommand
methods.description: Executes a command to check if a resource exists, handling exceptions.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Abstract method to execute a command; to be implemented by the class using this trait.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Abstract method to create commands; to be implemented by the class.

methods.name: getHandlerList
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve handler list; to be implemented by the class.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Abstract method to get iterator over resources; to be implemented by the class.
